item.description: The Chilean surf community is mourning the loss of 11-year-old surfer Gabriel Christensen Pérez, who died while surfing the left point of Puertecillo, Chile. item.title: ‘Lord of the Rings’ Director Says He Shot Around Surfing Injury Actor Incurred During Filming
item.description: Lord of the Rings director Peter Jackson revealed he had to change the way he filmed one scene due to a surfing injury Viggo Mortensen incurred during filming.

item.title: Why Explaining to Non-Surfers What Surfing Means to Your Life Can Sound Ridiculous
item.description: Have you ever tried to explain to a non-surfer how important surfing is in your life? It can be a futile endeavor bordering on the ridiculous.

item.title: Global Seaweed Blooms Have Scientists Warning of a ‘Regime Shift’ in the Ocean
item.description: The rise in Earth's overall temperatures paired with fertilizer runoff is making for ideal growing conditions. Good for seaweed, bad for a lot of other things.

item.title: Australians Warned To Stay Out of Water After Four Shark Attacks in 48 Hours
item.description: In an unprecedented sequence of events, dozens of Australian beaches have been closed in response to a rash of shark attacks along the New South Wales Coast.

item.title: Jamie O’Brien Tests His New Fun Day Surfboards at Massive Keiki Shorebreak
item.description: Jamie O'Brien calls Keiki "the heaviest shorebreak in the world." He took a few of his new Fun Day boards there for a test drive. And they held up.

item.title: Canadian Ski Resort Closes Indefinitely Amid Strike By 300 Workers
item.description: Le Massif de Charlevoix, a ski resort north of Quebec City, Canada announced it is closing indefinitely amid a strike by 300 of the resort's employees.

item.title: Jordy Smith Said This Was the ‘Best Surf of My Life’ and He Wasn’t Lying
item.description: Jordy Smith has many amazing sessions under his belt. But he called this session in Durban, South Africa the "best surf of my life." We're not going to argue.

item.title: Hiking Permits Could Be Coming to Southern California’s Mount Baldy
item.description: After the deaths of three hikers on the slopes of Mount Baldy, calls are growing to regulate use of the popular Southern California mountain.

item.title: Dozens of Skiers Trapped on Lift in French Alps
item.description: Dozens of skiers were trapped on a lift in a resort in the French Alps, with some having to be winched to safety by rescue helicopters.
